extracted.intended_audience: league-accredited members of the media (reporters, photographers, radio/TV) seeking Baltimore Ravens game or season credentials
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and requirements for media organizations and individuals to obtain Baltimore Ravens season or game-by-game media credentials, parking, field access, and related logistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Only league-accredited members of the media who cover the Ravens and the NFL on a regular basis may apply for credentials. The Ravens do not credential free lancers, colleges, cable outlets or websites (except for national sites such as ESPN.com).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must be league-accredited and have a regular coverage relationship with the Ravens/NFL; most freelancers, college outlets, cable outlets, and non-national websites are ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Season credential policy
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ravens' policy is to grant season credentials to media with whom we have a year-round relationship. Therefore, season media credentials for the 2025 season have already been assigned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Season credentials are reserved for year-round partners; if you do not meet those criteria you must apply on a game-by-game basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Season criterion — amount of coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Amount of coverage given to the Ravens throughout the season
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Volume/frequency of coverage across the season is a factor when awarding season credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Season criterion — intention/ability to cover home games
rubrics_metrics.description: Intention/ability to cover every Ravens home game, including the preseason
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrated ability or plan to attend all home games (including preseason) supports season credential approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Season criterion — coverage of road games
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage of some Ravens road games
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media that cover both home and some road contests are favored for season credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Season criterion — distribution of publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution of publication: free, subscription, on sale at newsstands, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How a publication is distributed (its reach and model) is considered in season credential decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Season criterion — radio/TV program format and audience size
rubrics_metrics.description: Radio or TV station program format and size of audience
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broadcast format and audience metrics (listener/viewer size) influence season credential eligibility for radio/TV outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Season criterion — attendance at in-season practices/press sessions
rubrics_metrics.description: Attendance at Ravens in-Season practices and press sessions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regular attendance at team practices and press opportunities during the season is taken into account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Season criterion — attendance at training camp
rubrics_metrics.description: Attendance at Ravens training camp
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participation in training camp coverage helps demonstrate a year-round relationship with the team.

rubrics_metrics.name: Season criterion — offseason coverage including NFL Draft
rubrics_metrics.description: Offseason coverage of the Ravens, including before, during and after the NFL Draft
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consistent offseason coverage (e.g., draft coverage) is part of the evaluation for season credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Game-by-game credential deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Game-by-game credentials must be applied for at least 10 days prior to game day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All game-by-game requests should be submitted no later than 10 days before the contest to be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-game request requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: No. You must request individual credentials for each Ravens home game using the online system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The online system requires one credential application per home game; you cannot request multiple games in a single application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Road game credential request process
rubrics_metrics.description: E-mail your request directly to Tom Valente at tom.valente@ravens.nfl.net a minimum of ten (10) days prior to the contest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All road-game credential requests must be sent via email to the named contact at least 10 days before the game.

rubrics_metrics.name: Named credential requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: We require names for each credential for several reasons: 1) to increase security and information of who has access to the stadium; 2) to eliminate last minute requests as much as possible; 3) to create a manifest to track everyone with stadium access for security purposes; and, 4) to create a database for tracking and ordering purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every requested credential must include the name of the individual who will use it; unnamed/placeholder requests are not acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Names must be provided by deadline; non-transferability
rubrics_metrics.description: You MUST have the names in order to complete the application - incomplete applications will not be processed. Credentials are non-transferable. If there are any changes from your original request you must contact us via email in advance of game day to change a credential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications missing names will be rejected. Credentials cannot be transferred between people; changes require advance email notification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Order acknowledgement and credential confirmation responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: You will receive an email that acknowledges receipt of your request. It is your responsibility to contact us 72 hours prior to kickoff to determine if you are, in fact, credentialed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After submitting, monitor your status and proactively confirm credential approval 72 hours before kickoff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Will Call pickup procedure and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Media must pick up their credentials in person at Media Will Call (located on the southeast corner of the stadium between Gate C and the Miller Lite Gatehouse) on game day. Media Will Call opens four (4) hours before kickoff (9 AM for a 1 PM game). You must show a current government issued ID, have all bags inspected and be subjected to a brief pat down.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bring government photo ID, expect bag inspection and a pat down; arrive when Media Will Call opens (4 hours prior) to pick up credentials in person.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photographer/videographer field-vest & armband requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Photographers and videographers must wear the appropriate vest and field access armband for field access during the game. Vests must be picked up and returned to Media Will Call.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Field access requires the designated vest and armband which are issued at Media Will Call and must be returned after use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photographer ID deposit while working
rubrics_metrics.description: You will be required to leave a current government issued photo I.D. at Media Will Call while you are working at the game.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Photographers/videographers must leave a government photo ID as a deposit while on-field credentials/vests are in use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parking allocation and confirmation
rubrics_metrics.description: Parking is limited and is available on a first come, first served basis. Tom Valente will issue your parking from a limited allotment. Email Tom.Valente@ravens.nfl.net 72 hours before kickoff to confirm parking status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parking is not guaranteed; confirm parking with the named contact 72 hours before kickoff to determine if you have been allocated a spot.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hotel accommodation request process
rubrics_metrics.description: Please e-mail BLTRV@ravens.nfl.com to inquire about hotel assistance. Hotel reservations may be requested by any media person who covers Ravens games on the road and will be granted based on room availability. Please be sure to include your name, media outlet, phone number, check in date, check out date and room type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Road-covering media may request hotel help by emailing BLTRV with full contact and reservation details; approval depends on availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credentialing point of contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact Tom.Valente@ravens.nfl.net for additional questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tom Valente is the primary contact for credential questions, parking confirmation, and road-game requests.
